descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Adam S. Ellison.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Adam S. Ellison's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2015 through 2026. The latest listed position is Program Manager.
The listed positions changed from Police Administrative Analyst in 2015 to Management Analyst II in 2016–2019, Project Manager in 2020, and Program Manager in 2021–2026.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.
